title: PERF-M2-T03: paired base/head tripwire, INCONCLUSIVE instead of skip, retired regression tools, provisional contract threshold
summary: Added tools/perf/tripwire.py (paired fresh-process base/head through compare(), one head-first diagnostic retry, non-blocking report, A/A calibrate), nightly lane reports INCONCLUSIVE instead of pytest.skip, removed check_perf_regression.py and perf_ci.py, and applied the owner-approved provisional threshold (max(5 ms, base x 1.40)) and section 5.2 dispositions to performance_contract.md. Measured A/A noise 0.35 on this VM; margin to the threshold is thin and flagged. DEV-022, INFRA-433.
